events.label: Brookings AIR research on community college credentials of value

slots.name: states using funding
slots.sentence: As of 2024, approximately 28 states use outcomes-based funding to allocate some portion of state funding to community colleges

slots.name: Texas performance funding
slots.sentence: Texas now allocates approximately 95% of state funds based on performance.

slots.name: Texas college spending
slots.sentence: Texas colleges with fewer than 4,000 students would need to spend 17% more to achieve adequate outcomes, whereas larger colleges had a smaller gap between their actual spending and spending needed to achieve adequate outcomes.
